attestations.value: The source reports that Dieudé left Crete in 1686 and settled in Milos, collaborating with Ottoman adversaries.

citations.exact_excerpt:
Il est donc tout à fait compréhensible que
l’ambassadeur Girardin, informé de la concurrence illicite provoquée par Dieudé
dans le négoce français, fît quelques démarches en 1686 pour qu’il fût expulsé
de l’île et renvoyé à Marseille.28 Et c’est ainsi que finalement, la même année,
Dieudé quitta la Crète;29 mais il n’alla pas très loin: il s’installa à Milos et, cette
fois-ci, il collabora avec les adversaires des Ottomans.

attestations.value: The consulted source reports that the Barbary corsairs raided the coasts of Italy, Spain, and the Mediterranean islands, sometimes advancing inland and capturing inhabitants into slavery.

citations.exact_excerpt:
The  corsairs  not  only  scoured  the  sea,  but 
often  raided  the  coasts  of  Italy,  Spain,  and  the  various 
Mediterranean  islands,  sometimes  advancing  consider- 
able distances  inland,  robbing  houses  and  villages  and 
carrying  off  the  inhabitants  into  slavery.

attestations.value: The passage mentions that corsairs operated from places such as Oran and Tlemcen, in the Mediterranean.

citations.exact_excerpt:
From 
these  places  the  rovers  issued  to  capture,  to  destroy, 
and  to  enslave :  in  Oran  and  Tlemcen,  in  Tenes, 
Shershell,  Bougie,  Jigelli,  Bizerta,  Sfax,  Susa, 
Monastir,  Jerbah,  and  Tripoli  they  lurked  ready 
for  the  raid  and  the  foray.
